verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own pages name a lead attorney (Joseph Asir) and state that every petition is reviewed by a licensed immigration attorney before filing. They also describe preparation, attorney review and USCIS filing as handled within one accountable immigration team, so this is not an unsupervised form service. However, the site also says "LegalOS Inc. is not a law firm," which makes the model attorney review rather than a stated attorney-of-record engagement. Missing for 10: an explicit attorney-of-record or law-firm engagement statement, evidence that attorneys (not the platform) prepare the petition itself, bar or license details for the named attorney, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service
